title: Federal money collected vs spent, by province

hook.question: Where does Ottawa collect more than it spends?

plan.line: provinces and territories where Ottawa collected more than it spent: Alberta, Ontario, B.C.
more collected than spent there; every year was positive except 2020
the largest gap the other way: more spent than collected

summary.sub:
Across Canada, Ottawa spent $555 billion more than it collected over these years (deficits), so most places show more spent than collected.
Source: Statistics Canada, Table 36-10-0450-01.

note: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 36-10-0450-01 (federal general government revenue minus expenditure, allocated to provinces by Statistics Canada). Calendar years, current dollars, not adjusted for inflation. Totals are sums of published yearly values; colours glide between years as animation.
method: For each province and territory: sum over calendar years of Statistics Canada's published federal 'surplus or deficit' (revenue minus expenditure) in the provincial economic accounts. Current dollars, not inflation-adjusted. Federal activity outside Canada is excluded from the map. Map colour moves between consecutive years as animation; printed totals are sums of published values through the year on screen.
